name: True Daylight
body:
School evocation [light]; Level cleric/oracle 6, druid 6, legendary inquisitor 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target divine focus touched
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This is identical to the daylight spell, except it uses a divine focus and is the equivalent of daylight for the purposes of creatures that are damaged or destroyed by such light.
